content: Contact form anti-spam: layered defense; honeypot with realistic field name (company/website) validated server-side plus time-to-submit check; per-IP rate limit around 3-5/hour; CAPTCHA adds friction for everyone so rate limit + honeypot preferred for low-traffic sites. Cal.com offers inline, floating button, click popup and plain link; no benchmark found, but link or click-triggered popup avoids third-party script on initial load. Nothing found on response-time promises.
